newsitem.title: USA: OPTIONS - Time decay presses U.S. debt volatility.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Time decay presses U.S. debt volatility.

text.p: Implied volatilities for most U.S. interest rate options eased as attention turned to the coming long holiday weekend.

The day after the Federal Reserve raised the federal funds target by 1/4 point to 5.5 percent, volatility levels for Treasury bond options were steady to lower and generally expected to remain on a downward path as the week draws to an early close ahead of the Easter holiday.
U.S. debt futures and options markets will trade a shortened session Thursday and will be closed Friday.
